answer: Before receiving full rewards, an identity must answer four unpredictable challenges separated by at least six hours and obtain four-of-seven signatures from randomly sampled established graders on each. Missing a round restarts the ladder and burns a 30 POA bond. Every extra fake identity needs a separate 24-hour sequence, bond, and 16 honest signatures; timestamps, random seeds, answers, and signatures are verified on the shared ledger. Auditors tag the bond gale, the random draw vertex, and the signed receipt garden, so every verifier can trace all three.
